name: PA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Madeleine Dean running with strong fundraising
District leans Democratic by about 8 points on the PVI
Challenger Aurora Stuski has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Dean is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic, while her challenger has shown no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable Dean win, so the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a dramatically different national environment or unexpected challenger spending could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Madeleine Dean seeks another term in a suburban Philadelphia district that voted about eight points more Democratic than the nation in recent cycles. She has raised roughly $1.4 million and holds over $1.1 million on hand, while Republican Aurora Stuski has reported no fundraising and draws no outside spending. No public polls cover the race, and no expert raters have weighed in.

Prediction markets put Dean's chances near 95 percent, consistent with the district's lean and her incumbency advantage. The expected margin sits around 20 points, though uncertainty is elevated because the race lacks polling. Dean remains a strong favorite.
